```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
data_path = "path/to/data/"

output_path  = "path/to/outputs/"
```

Data from: https://github.com/OxCGRT/covid-policy-dataset/blob/main/data/OxCGRT_compact_national_v1.csv

```{r}
stringency_idx <- fread(paste0(data_path, "OxCGRT_compact_national_v1.csv"))

stringency_idx_fin <- stringency_idx %>%
  filter(CountryName == "Finland") %>%
  select(CountryName, CountryCode, Date, StringencyIndex_Average) %>%
  mutate(Date_format = paste0(substr(Date, 1,4), "-", substr(Date, 5,6), "-", substr(Date, 7,8)),
         Date_format = as.Date(Date_format, format="%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  arrange((Date_format))

```

```{r}
line_dates <- as.Date(c("2020-01-01", "2021-01-01", "2022-01-01", "2023-01-01"))


stringency_index_plot <- ggplot(data=stringency_idx_fin, aes(x=Date_format, y=StringencyIndex_Average)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y-%m-%d",
               date_breaks = "1 month") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = line_dates,
             linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x="Date", y="Stringency Index")

ggsave(stringency_index_plot, file = paste0(output_path, "stringency_index.jpg"), 
        width = 10, height = 7, units = "in", dpi=300)
```
